name: Regions of Czech Republic
author: Addicting Games
description: Regions of the Czech Republic is an educational map game that will touch up your knowledge of the Czech Republic. Whether you need to study this for school or just want to show off your geography knowledge, Regions of the Czech Republic is a fun and quick game that will brush up your skills. Ever wondered where Prague is or how big it is? Well now is your chance to learn about the beautiful regions of the Czech Republic. There are 14 regions for you to identify. Since this is an educational game, even if you get it wrong, the game will give you a quick hint telling you where it actually is. At the end of the game, you’ll receive your score and the time it took you to get you there. Beat both your score and time by playing again and remembering the hints the game gave you before. Practice makes perfect!
